searchText: hi everyone, i have a question. what will happen to an ethereum chain if the majority of the validators will go offline indefinitely, will the chain stall or will it automatically recover? The chain will not even stall for a while, it will lower throghput as there will be many missed blocks, but the chain will advance and eventually finalize again after kicking out the offline validators
